craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha of attainment — verbs are all attainments. Sky-lady + lakes dived; stir-the-inert imperative; broḍayet print noted per UNC. Rejected: (a) lakes→waters → killed: lakes are stations. Read aloud: SKY-go-ERS … STIR the-IN-ert.

lines: Sky-goers and her four streams, flowing, full, great lakes —
sky-Lady, self-knowing — dived in, stir the inert.
l4.sanskrit_cite: khecaryādicatussrotovāhapūrṇamahāhradām | vyomeśvarīm ātmacitiṃ vigāhya broḍayej jaḍam

reads_against.argmap: How dive sky-goddess lakes? → Streamed lakes dived; inert agitated.
